description: Convenience wrapper: create a Bold payment link restricted to cards (payment_methods=["CREDIT_CARD"]).

amount_type.description: CLOSE for a fixed amount (default), OPEN lets the payer type the amount

callback_url.description: URL the payer is redirected to after paying

description.description: What the payer sees on the checkout page

expiration_date.description: Link expiry as a Unix timestamp in NANOSECONDS (Bold convention). Omit for no expiry.

payer_email.description: Prefill the payer's email on the checkout page

total_amount.description: Total amount in COP (required when amount_type=CLOSE)

name: create_card_payment_link
